item_name: Rothco M-1 Jungle First Aid Kit Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s M-1 Jungle First Aid Kit Pouch is constructed with durable canvas material and is made portable with belt clips. The double buttons on the front of the pouch allows for a secure closure. This compact first aid kit measure 5 ¼” wide and 5 ½” high. This pouch is sold without the first aid items.
